note: 1884 arrival, 3 staves (figs_new/p093_s00-s02.png). minor-scale strain (figs_new/p094_s00.png). No key signature at the clef (0 sharps/flats) -> A minor. Scale run G5-G#5(sharp, ledger-free space above staff)-A5(ledger line, confirmed twice)-A5-G5(explicit natural sign cancelling the sharp, dotted)-F5-E5-D5(descending, stepwise, on/around the staff lines), ending on a fermata rest before the final barline. The G#5->G-natural pair is a textbook melodic-minor raised-leading-tone/natural-descent, which is strong internal confirmation of A minor and of the pitch reading.

Curly curly Hey! Chickerway (figs_new/p094_s01.png + p094_s02.png). Independent re-read from scratch: differs substantially from the old low-conf draft (Bb4/G4/Eb5/D5/C5), which was checked against a mis-calibrated staff reference. Correct treble reading (verified via measured staff-line y-pixels) puts this whole figure in the Eb5-F5-C5 register: 'Cur-ly cur-ly' = Eb5-F5 alternation (8ths, accented on F5); 'Hey!' = F5 quarter note (forte, no flag - not an 8th); 'Chick-er-way' (x2, 16ths) = Eb5-C5-F5, a 3-note figure that recurs identically in both crops, a strong cross-check. p094_s02 continues with 'chew' (F5-Eb5 16th pair), rest, 'cur-ly cur-ly' (Eb5-F5 x2, 8ths), rest, 'cur-ly' (Eb5 dotted-8th + F5 16th) to the final barline.
